definitions.explanation: An official act by the government forgiving or reducing the punishment of convicted individuals. In Japan, granted by the Cabinet with the Emperor's attestation.

examples.japanese: {恩赦|おんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{即位|そくい}→即位：11974_sokui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{恩赦|おんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An amnesty was carried out to mark the enthronement ceremony.

examples.japanese: {恩赦|おんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧{両論|りょうろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。

notes:
A formal legal and political term. In Japan, {恩赦|おんしゃ} is traditionally granted on occasions of national celebration, such as the enthronement of a new emperor or major state anniversaries. The practice is governed by the Amnesty Act ({恩赦法|おんしゃほう}). Composed of ⟦{恩|おん}→恩：02550_on⟧ (grace/favor) + {赦|しゃ} (pardon/forgive).

TYPES OF AMNESTY:
- {大赦|たいしゃ}: general amnesty — broad pardon for many offenders
- {特赦|とくしゃ}: special pardon — pardon for specific individuals
- {減刑|げんけい}: commutation — reduction of sentence
- {復権|ふっけん}: restoration of rights — restoring civil rights lost due to conviction

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恩赦|おんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to grant amnesty
- {恩赦|おんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive amnesty
- {恩赦|おんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to carry out an amnesty
- {恩赦|おんしゃ}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: the amnesty system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {特赦|とくしゃ}: special pardon — a pardon for a specific individual, as opposed to a broad amnesty
- {減刑|げんけい}: commutation of sentence — reducing a punishment without fully pardoning
- ⟦{釈放|しゃくほう}→釈放：14806_shakuhou⟧: release — freeing someone from prison, not necessarily with a pardon
